rows.whatChanged: ONE FAMILY, ONE BOX. `dinfo` is now a COMPOSED WRITE instead of a SUPPLY refusal, composed exactly as the sibling scripts/build-census-v1-mi_setaside_trafficking-set.mjs composes the identically captioned box on MC 227b: the same shared finalizer channel (composedFieldValues in scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-official-form-finalize.mjs, which takes FACT IDS rather than text and refuses the whole box unless every named fact is held, so a partial contact block cannot reach the page), the same three fact ids in the order the printed caption names them (participant.full_legal_name, participant.street_address, participant.phone), the same one-fact-per-line layout and the same 9pt ceiling. In scripts/build-census-v1-mi_setaside_marihuana-set.mjs: a COMPOSE() helper beside the existing SUPPLY/WRITE/PROTECT/ELECTION/ATTORNEY helpers; the dinfo dictionary entry; the census row carries composedFrom/composedMaxFontSize/composedHow; renderDocument builds composedFieldValues and keeps the composed field out of unwritableFields (that role gate is not overridable) and passes fitTextPerWidget; byteProof proves a composed box FACT BY FACT against the ink the finished page carries and asserts that a box short of any one of its facts stops the build; mapFor emits the composed write with composed:true and no refusal row; countCompleteness counts a composed box's facts as held; and four in-build self-tests, modelled on the trafficking builder's "the Parties box must be a composed write, not a refusal", assert the fact ids and their order, that both fixtures hold all three, that dinfo is on the written side of the map and on no refusal side, and that both byte proofs found all three facts. THE READ-BACK ENCODING. The first build failed its own new assertion on the boundary fixture: the surname's U+2019 is drawn as WinAnsi 0x92 and this builder read the appearance back as Latin-1, which turns it into an invisible control character. That is the same reading error the trafficking family already corrected, and the same WIN_ANSI_HIGH translation is applied here to the read-back only; the apostrophe is on the page. RECORDS: the header comment, the dinfo row's `why` in production-field-map.json, the dinfo finding in build-findings.json and the apostrophe advisory beside it now record the repair; no record still says the platform cannot compose the block. The dinfo row leaves participant-instructions.md's supply table by itself (requiredBeforeFilingCount 26 -> 25) and the opening sentence now names what the platform filled in, contact block included; reports/independent-visual-review.json now asks the reviewer to look at three filled lines rather than at an empty box. NOT TOUCHED: every other field of MC 227a, the trafficking family, the shared finalizer, the shared completeness contract, every queue and every legal record.
